delivery.question: My order has not started yet, what should I do?
delivery.answer: An order usually starts within minutes, sometimes up to a few hours. If nothing moves after 24 h, open a ticket with the order number.

partial.question: My order was only partly delivered, why?
partial.answer: Sometimes only part of the quantity can be delivered. You are then charged only for what was delivered, and the rest is returned to you.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Every request is reviewed by our team. Open a ticket explaining the problem: we reply within 24 h.

rechargeMissing.question: I paid but my balance did not change.
rechargeMissing.answer: A payment can take a few minutes to arrive. If nothing changes after 30 minutes, open a ticket with the amount and the time of the payment.

privateLink.question: Why must my link be public?
privateLink.answer: A private account or post cannot receive the order. Make the account public during delivery, then set it back to private.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about adding funds, orders and your account.

1.question: How do I add funds to my balance?
1.answer: On the Add funds page, choose an amount and pay with Mobile Money. Once the payment is confirmed, the amount is added to your balance.

2.question: Which amounts can I add?
2.answer: From 500 to 500,000 XAF per top-up. Payment fees may apply: they are shown before you confirm.

3.question: Can I withdraw my balance?
3.answer: No. Your balance is only used to pay for orders on LyonPanel. It cannot be converted to cash or withdrawn.

1.question: How do I place an order?
1.answer: Choose a service, paste the link to your profile or post, enter the quantity, then confirm. The site calculates the total price and takes it from your balance.

2.question: Does my profile need to be public?
2.answer: Yes. The service cannot act on a private account: set it to public while your order runs.

3.question: What if there is a problem with an order?
3.answer: Open a ticket from your account with the order number. The owner reviews each case. Refunds are never automatic: they are decided after review.

1.question: How do I create an account?
1.answer: Sign up with an email address and a password, then confirm your address.

2.question: Can I change language or currency?
2.answer: Yes. The site is available in French and English, and prices can be shown in XAF or another currency. Payments are always made in XAF.

1.question: Do you ask for my Instagram or TikTok password?
1.answer: Never. We only need the public link to your profile or post.

2.question: How do I contact support?
2.answer: Through a ticket from your customer area. The Contact page explains how to reach us.

q1.question: How do I order Instagram services?
q1.answer: Create an account, top up your balance with Mobile Money or card (500 to 500,000 XAF), pick a service, then enter the link and the quantity. The server calculates the total before you confirm.

q2.question: How is the price calculated?
q2.answer: Each service has a price per 1,000 units, shown in XAF. Your order total is that price times the quantity, rounded up to the next multiple of 5 XAF. The server recalculates it on every order.

q3.question: What quantity can I order?
q3.answer: Each service has its own minimum and maximum quantity, shown on the order form. They differ from one service to another.

q4.question: Do I need my Instagram password?
q4.answer: No. You only give the public link to the profile or post. Never share your password.
